notes.title: Notice of Transfer to PLAYISM
notes.content:
TorqueL, which has been available on Steam since January 23rd, 2015,
had been self-published by FullPowerSideAttack.com until now.
From here on, we will transfer publishing rights to PLAYISM (Active Gaming Media Inc.).
In accordancwe with this transfer, the publisher name on the store page will be changed to PLAYISM within the next few days.

PLAYISM is publisher of the PS4/PSVita/Nintendo Switch versions of TorqueL.
In order to ensure that TorqueL could remain available on Steam in the future,
we decided that it would be best to entrust publishing to a trustworthy publisher with the appropriate knowledge and experience, rather than committing to self-publishing TorqueL on our own.

The transfer of TorqueL to PLAYISM will not affect those who have already purchased the game, and there is nothing you need to do.
The game itself and its various features will be remain exactly the same.
Note: There are no plans for special updates after the transfer.

Luckily, I was afforded the opportunity to self-publish TorqueL as second prize at Intel Level Up 2013, and I've been able to directly see and feel the various changes in both Steam and the game industry over the past several years.
Thank you for almost four years of invaluable support via Steam.

FullPowerSideAttack.com Representative and Developer
Takayuki Yanagihara (Nanmo)

-------------

PLAYISMへの移管についてのお知らせ

2015年1月23日よりSteamで販売しております、トルクル(TorqueL)について、
FullPowerSideAttack.com セルフパブリッシュから、
PLAYISM(アクティブゲーミングメディア) パブリッシュに移管いたします。
Valveの作業により、数日中にストアページのパブリッシャーがPLAYISMに変更される予定です。

PLAYISMはトルクル(TorqueL) PS4/PSVita/NintendoSwitch版のパブリッシャーであり、
トルクル(TorqueL)を今後もSteamで継続して販売していくにあたっては、
開発者自ら時間を使ってセルフパブリッシュを維持するよりも、知見と信頼のあるパブリッシャーにお任せすることが最良であると判断しました。

トルクル(TorqueL)のPLAYISMへの移管にあたり、すでに購入いただいた方の権利はそのまま保持されますので、何か手続きを取っていただく必要はありません。
トルクル(TorqueL)のゲーム本体・機能はこれまでの状態のまま提供されます。
(※移管後に特別なアップデートを行う予定はありません)

幸運なことに、Intel Level Up 2013の副賞としてTorqueLをセルフパブリッシュができるようになってから、現在までSteamやゲーム業界の変化を直に感じることができました。
Steamでの約4年にわたるサポートに深く感謝いたします。

FullPowerSideAttack.com 代表兼開発者 なんも/柳原隆幸

notes.title: [Release] TorqueL ver.1.0.2 implemented the simple save(resume) function.
notes.content:
[url=http://fullpowersideattack.com/post/110863257047/torquel-windows-1-0-2]日本語の説明はこちら[/url]

[b]I released TorqueL ver.1.0.2 that implemented the simple save(resume) function.[/b]

[h1]Save(Resume) function description[/h1]
[list]
[*]Upon reaching a goal, the game will record which chamber is next and the time taken to reach that goal. (There will be only one save file; if save data exists, it will be overwritten.)
[*]If save data exists when the game is loaded, a goal labeled "Continue" will appear on the left side of the first screen. If that goal is entered, the player will start at the recorded chamber with the recorded time passed.
[*]Once the player reaches the end of the game, the save data will be reset and the Continue goal will disappear. If the game is played again and new save data is created, the Continue goal will reappear.
[*]No save data will be created for the first stage or for certain special stages.
[/list]

[h1]Supplemental[/h1]
[list]
[*]For example, upon clearing Chamber02, save data will be created allowing the player to continue from Chamber03.
[*]When shifting to Chamber01 from Title, TorqueL doesn't save.
[*]When reaching a goal of Chamber10, TorqueL saves so that it may begin from Chamber11. (TorqueL doesn't save a staging chamber.)
[*]When detecting unjust data, a Continue goal isn't indicated.
[/list]

[h1]Saving data place[/h1]

[code]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\FullPowerSideAttack_com\TorqueL\LastChamberMemory.dat[/code]

Further, TorqueL can't sometimes normally write files in following setting and at state.

[list]
[*]Was set to "read only" file/folder property.
[*]Was set to "hide" file/folder property.
[*]File writing lock by other softwares
[*]Security settings, Etc...,
[/list]

If you get trouble, please check list in above.

I hope enjoy your playing.

Cheers,

notes.title: TorqueL ver.1.0.1 Bug fixes and plans for implementing a save function
notes.content:
[url=http://fullpowersideattack.com/post/109484541697/torquel-ver-1-0-1][日本語での説明はこちら][/url]

The next update(ver.1.0.1) will include fixes for the following bugs.(Published)

* Inability to progress if "Back to Title" is selected before restarting after failing a level

Thank you for playing and your feedbacks!

I'm happy with most reviewers said they loved TorqueL's game design concept.
Also I understand that you expect a save function to be implemented too.
so I'm looking into How I can implement save method for TorqueL without disrupting original game design.

I'm planning on the following implementation.

[list]
[*] Upon reaching a goal, the game will record which chamber is next and the time taken to reach that goal. (There will be only one save file; if save data exists, it will be overwritten.) For example, upon clearing Chamber02, save data will be created allowing the player to continue from Chamber03.
[*] If save data exists when the game is loaded, a goal labeled "Continue" will appear on the left side of the first screen. If that goal is entered, the player will start at the recorded chamber with the recorded time passed.
[*] Once the player reaches the end of the game, the save data will be reset and the Continue goal will disappear. If the game is played again and new save data is created, the Continue goal will reappear.
[*] No save data will be created for the first stage or for certain special stages.
[/list]

I expect it will take no more than two weeks to implement.

However, the game is basically being developed by one person, so it's possible that an accident or something may cause a delay in implementation.

notes.title: TorqueL ver.1.0.1 Bug fixes and plans for implementing a save function
notes.content:
[url=http://fullpowersideattack.com/post/109484541697/torquel-ver-1-0-1][日本語での説明はこちら][/url]

The next update(ver.1.0.1) will include fixes for the following bugs.(Published)

* Inability to progress if "Back to Title" is selected before restarting after failing a level

Thank you for playing and your feedbacks!

I'm happy with most reviewers said they loved TorqueL's game design concept.
Also I understand that you expect a save function to be implemented too.
so I'm looking into How I can implement save method for TorqueL without disrupting original game design.

I'm planning on the following implementation.

[list]
[*] Upon reaching a goal, the game will record which chamber is next and the time taken to reach that goal. (There will be only one save file; if save data exists, it will be overwritten.) For example, upon clearing Chamber02, save data will be created allowing the player to continue from Chamber03.
[*] If save data exists when the game is loaded, a goal labeled "Continue" will appear on the left side of the first screen. If that goal is entered, the player will start at the recorded chamber with the recorded time passed.
[*] Once the player reaches the end of the game, the save data will be reset and the Continue goal will disappear. If the game is played again and new save data is created, the Continue goal will reappear.
[*] No save data will be created for the first stage or for certain special stages.
[/list]

I expect it will take no more than two weeks to implement.

However, the game is basically being developed by one person, so it's possible that an accident or something may cause a delay in implementation.
